b2-hatarontul-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Life in Székelyföld
b2-hatarontul-01.scenario: In Kolozsvár, a visitor from abroad asks you how Hungarians in the Székelyföld keep their traditions when the official environment is Romanian.
b2-hatarontul-01.prompt: Tell the visitor how people in the Székelyföld keep their traditions and their language.
cues: Say that they keep their traditions even if the official environment is Romanian
Say that in the villages they speak Hungarian
b2-hatarontul-01.target: A Székelyföld lakói ápolják a hagyományokat, még akkor is, ha a hivatalos környezet román. A falvakban magyarul beszélnek.
b2-hatarontul-01.english: The people of the Székelyföld keep up their traditions, even if the official environment is Romanian. In the villages they speak Hungarian.
b2-hatarontul-01.canDo: I can describe the contemporary cultural life of Hungarians in Transylvania and Székelyföld.

b2-hatarontul-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Bridges of Komárom
b2-hatarontul-02.scenario: On the Danube bridge in Komárom, a visitor from Budapest asks you what the bridges mean for the people of the town.
b2-hatarontul-02.prompt: Tell her what the bridges mean for the town, and what many people would do even if commuting were difficult.
cues: Say that Komárom is a bridge city on the Danube
Say that students and commuters cross every day
Say that many people would take the work even if commuting were difficult
b2-hatarontul-02.target: Komárom hídváros a Duna két partján, a diákok és az ingázók naponta átmennek a hídon. Még ha nehéz lenne is az ingázás, sokan vállalnák a munkát.
b2-hatarontul-02.english: Komárom is a bridge city on both banks of the Danube, and students and commuters cross the bridge every day. Even if commuting were difficult, many people would take the work.
b2-hatarontul-02.canDo: I can describe Hungarian community life in southern Slovakia (Felvidék) and northern Serbia (Vajdaság).

b2-hatarontul-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Mother-Tongue Education
b2-hatarontul-03.scenario: At a conference in Komárom, a student from Beregszász asks you why mother-tongue colleges and universities matter.
b2-hatarontul-03.prompt: Tell the student what the college in Beregszász does and what young people can gain from education in Hungarian.
cues: Say that the college in Beregszász goes on teaching, whatever the situation
Say that young people can get a degree in their mother tongue
b2-hatarontul-03.target: A beregszászi főiskola folytatja az oktatást, függetlenül attól, hogy nehéz a helyzet. A fiatalok anyanyelvükön szerezhetnek diplomát.
b2-hatarontul-03.english: The college in Beregszász continues teaching, regardless of the situation being difficult. Young people can earn a degree in their mother tongue.
b2-hatarontul-03.canDo: I can describe Hungarian higher education, theatres, and cultural institutions across neighboring countries.

b2-hatarontul-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Citizenship Law of 2010
b2-hatarontul-04.scenario: At the Hungarian consulate in Szabadka, a young woman asks you what the citizenship law of 2010 changed.
b2-hatarontul-04.prompt: Tell her when parliament passed the law and what many people did in spite of the difficulties.
cues: Say when parliament adopted the law
Say that in spite of the difficulties many people took Hungarian citizenship
b2-hatarontul-04.target: Az Országgyűlés 2010 májusában elfogadta az egyszerűsített honosításról szóló törvénymódosítást. A nehézségek dacára sokan felvették a magyar állampolgárságot.
b2-hatarontul-04.english: In May 2010 parliament adopted the amendment on simplified naturalisation. In spite of the difficulties, many people took Hungarian citizenship.
b2-hatarontul-04.canDo: I can explain the background and practical reality of Hungary's simplified naturalization act.

b2-hatarontul-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Bridge at Esztergom
b2-hatarontul-05.scenario: On the bridge between Esztergom and Párkány, a cyclist asks you what the bridge means for the region.
b2-hatarontul-05.prompt: Tell the cyclist what the bridge does and why cooperation continues whatever the political debates.
cues: Say that the bridge connects Esztergom and Párkány
Say that commuters cross it every day
Say that, however difficult the debates may be, the communities cooperate
b2-hatarontul-05.target: A Mária Valéria híd összeköti Esztergomot és Párkányt, és az ingázók naponta átmennek rajta. Bármilyen nehezek legyenek is a politikai viták, a helyi közösségek együttműködnek.
b2-hatarontul-05.english: The Mária Valéria bridge connects Esztergom and Párkány, and commuters cross it every day. However difficult the political debates may be, the local communities cooperate.
b2-hatarontul-05.canDo: I can describe cross-border regional cooperation, Euroregions, and infrastructure connections in Central Europe.

b2-hatarontul-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Hungarians Beyond the Borders
b2-hatarontul-consolidation.scenario: At a conference in Kolozsvár, a guest from Budapest asks you to sum up how Hungarian communities beyond the borders keep their language.
b2-hatarontul-consolidation.prompt: Tell the guest where young people can study in Hungarian and what holds the communities together.
cues: Say that young people can study in their mother tongue wherever they live
Say that the communities hold on to their mother tongue even if the official environment is Romanian
b2-hatarontul-consolidation.target: A fiatalok anyanyelvükön tanulhatnak, függetlenül attól, hogy melyik országban élnek. Még akkor is ragaszkodnak az anyanyelvükhöz, ha a hivatalos környezet román.
b2-hatarontul-consolidation.english: Young people can study in their mother tongue, regardless of which country they live in. They hold on to their mother tongue even if the official environment is Romanian.
b2-hatarontul-consolidation.canDo: I can analyze the institutional, educational, and cultural life of Hungarian communities across the Carpathian Basin.
